heading_styles.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-black
heading_styles.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-black

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Asymmetric layouts where appropriate. Sharp contrast.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 bg-black text-white h-screen sticky top-0 flex flex-col
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento-style grids for dashboards. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6.

buttons.style: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), generous horizontal padding (px-8 py-3). No subtle shadows.

cards.style: Solid block accents. 8px border-radius (rounded-lg) or sharp edges. No soft drop shadows, prefer hard 2px borders or offset solid shadows for a brutalist/Swiss feel.

charts.style: Solid colors, no gradients. Clean, thick lines or solid bars.

navigation.sidebar_links: Duolingo-style. Large clickable areas, bold text, high contrast hover states (e.g., hover:bg-[#2D2D2D]). Active state: bg-[#2D2D2D] with #2CFF05 text or left border.

pages.auth_landing: Hero the logo and 'Outperform. Climb. Earn.' value prop. Black background, massive Unbounded typography in white and green. Google OAuth button prominently displayed.
pages.editor_dashboard: White background. Top stats bar with varying card backgrounds (Green for Total Points, Purple for Earnings, Dark for Rank). Active Campaigns in a bold grid. Recent activity list.
pages.creator_dashboard: Similar layout. Campaign Performance charts using the mandated 4-color palette.
pages.campaigns: Gallery view with filter/sort chips (rounded-full bg-[#2D2D2D] text-white). Cards display bounty, deadline. Creation wizard uses a clean multi-step flow.
pages.clip_submission: Form with clear inputs, large tap targets, screenshot upload area with dashed border in #2D2D2D.
pages.leaderboard: Podium top-3 highlighting. Rank change arrows in #2CFF05. 'Your row' highlighted in #2CFF05 or #BF00FF.
pages.resources: Grid of content cards, thumbnails of video editing.
pages.profile: Public portfolio view. Asymmetric layout with large avatar, bold stats, and clip gallery.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use ANY colors outside of #000000, #2CFF05, #BF00FF, #2D2D2D, and #FFFFFF. This is a strict constraint.
Do NOT use gradients. Use solid block colors for backgrounds, buttons, and charts.
Install and configure 'Unbounded' (headings) and 'IBM Plex Sans' (body) fonts.
Sidebar MUST be black (#000000), content area MUST be white (#FFFFFF).
All interactive elements and key text MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="campaign-card-button"`).
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to remove default soft shadows and gray borders. Apply solid #2D2D2D or black borders instead.
Follow a brutalist/Swiss high-contrast aesthetic. Tension and contrast are key.
Ensure contrast ratios are accessible, especially text on the #2CFF05 and #BF00FF backgrounds.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide icons for sharp, technical iconography.
